name: ISO
role: Publishes international standards; members are national bodies. Source of the numbering that national adoptions keep (IS/ISO 13485, KS P ISO13485, EN ISO 13485).
provenance: from general knowledge; not verified in this session

name: IEC
role: Electrotechnical counterpart; IEC numbers survive in EN 6xxxx, IS/IEC, KS C IEC, GB/T xxxx/IEC.
provenance: from general knowledge; not verified in this session

name: ISO/IEC Guide 21-1 (2005)
role: Defines how national/regional standards state their degree of correspondence to an International Standard (identical/modified/not equivalent) and how identical adoptions are numbered.

name: Vienna Agreement (ISO-CEN, 1991)
role: Parallel voting and common planning so one text becomes both ISO and EN; about 31% of CEN standards are developed this way.

name: Frankfurt Agreement (IEC-CENELEC)
role: Common planning and parallel voting in electrotechnology; CENELEC cites ~80% of its standards as identical to or based on IEC (older slide: 72% identical, 6% based on, 22% unrelated).

name: WTO TBT Agreement, Annex 3 Code of Good Practice
role: Obliges members' central standardizing bodies to use international standards as the basis for national ones where they exist; acceptance is notified to the ISO/IEC Information Centre in Geneva.

name: ISO/IEC Information Centre (TBT enquiry point, tbtcode.iso.org)
role: Registry of bodies that accepted the TBT Code and their work programmes.

name: Eurocodes + National Annexes (CEN/TC 250)
role: Same EN text everywhere; each country sets Nationally Determined Parameters in its own National Annex, so one standard becomes many country variants.

name: EU harmonised standards (European Commission)
role: EN standards cited in the OJEU give presumption of conformity with EU directives (machinery, pressure equipment, ATEX...). Links standards to law and product segments. Collected in catalog/eu_harmonised.csv.
provenance: from general knowledge; not verified in this session

name: Incorporation by reference (US eCFR, ANSI IBR portal)
role: US regulations name specific ASTM/ASME/API/NFPA editions, tying private standards to law and to sectors.
provenance: from general knowledge; not verified in this session

name: IAF MLA and ILAC MRA
role: Mutual recognition of accreditation, so a certificate or test report to the same standard is accepted across countries.
provenance: from general knowledge; not verified in this session

name: BIPM CIPM MRA
role: Mutual recognition of national measurement standards, underpinning test methods in all sectors.
provenance: from general knowledge; not verified in this session

name: ITC Standards Map
role: Database of voluntary sustainability standards and their requirements; compares standards across sectors.
provenance: from general knowledge; not verified in this session

name: ICS (ISO) and HS (WCO) classification
role: ICS codes group standards by subject across bodies; HS codes link traded products to the standards and regulations that apply to them.
provenance: from general knowledge; not verified in this session

name: Codex Alimentarius
role: Food standards referenced by national food regulations and recognised under the WTO SPS Agreement.
provenance: from general knowledge; not verified in this session

name: UNECE WP.29
role: Vehicle regulations accepted across contracting parties under the 1958 Agreement.
provenance: from general knowledge; not verified in this session

name: Regional bodies: ARSO (Africa), COPANT (Americas), PASC (Pacific), ACCSQ (ASEAN), GSO (Gulf), EAC, COMESA, EASC (CIS)
role: Harmonise national standards inside a bloc; Public.Resource.Org carries ARSO, GCC, COMESA texts (catalog/lawresorg_world.csv).
provenance: from general knowledge; not verified in this session

name: ANSI NSSN and NIST Standards Coordinating Office
role: Search and coordination services across US standards developers.
provenance: from general knowledge; not verified in this session
